concerns.text: FR-007 (Text-Weight Alignment) and SC-005 (Linearity Assumption) lack a dedicated task to generate the 'held-out set of known task pairs' and their 'true weights' required for the Pearson correlation and reconstruction error calculations. T022g attempts to generate these but is marked as incomplete/missing in the plan context, and T030 depends on it. Without a task explicitly producing `known_composites_pairs.yaml` and `true_weights`, FR-007 and SC-005 are untestable.

FR-004 (Apply adapters & evaluate) and SC-001 (Success rate vs baseline) lack a complete execution path. T026 (runner) depends on T026a (GGUF model) and T026e (baseline adapter). T026a and T026e are marked as incomplete/missing in the provided context. There is no task to actually download/convert the base model or synthesize the baseline adapter if the primary sources fail, leaving the evaluation loop (FR-004) and the primary success metric (SC-001) unimplementable.

SC-004 (Sensitivity Analysis) requires measuring performance against varying top-k values. While T031a implements the logic, T031b (Execute sweeps) is marked as incomplete. Without the execution task, the sensitivity analysis data required for SC-004 and the BH correction in FR-006 cannot be generated.

FR-006 (Benjamini-Hochberg correction) requires p-values from 'primary comparisons and sensitivity sweeps'. T029 implements the stats logic, but it depends on T027 (multiple runs) and T031b (sensitivity sweeps). Since T027 and T031b are incomplete/missing, the input data for FR-006 is absent, making the requirement untestable.

T012 includes a fallback instruction to 'generate synthetic proxy weights' if real weights are unavailable, but the task is marked as incomplete. The task description implies the fallback is part of the task, but the execution status suggests the fallback logic or the synthetic generation itself is not yet realized, creating a gap in the data pipeline for US1.
